evidence: Adds a new 568-line end-to-end fuzzing harness (src/test/fuzz/p2p_1p1c_liveness.cpp) and updates fuzz build configuration in src/test/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt.
rationale: The PR introduces an end-to-end P2P fuzz harness (p2p_1p1c_liveness) that drives PeerManager with real messages and validation to verify 1p1c relay invariants under adversarial conditions. The description highlights that the target covers high-risk P2P message handling paths and catches realistic regressions, noting that it 'finds this bug on master from an empty corpus in under an hour on one core' while also enabling #36506.
